scope: Existing five BU Green Line B platforms and Commonwealth median. Architectural scenery, not live MBTA arrivals or a reconstruction of temporary works.

sources.supports: Four 225-foot low-level platforms and 150-foot steel canopies, accessible walks, signage, benches and lighting. These lengths were already represented and are unchanged.

Amory and Babcock replaced the previous four-stop arrangement in November 2021. Inspected opening photo: white curved canopy ribs, pale structural posts on concrete bases, long yellow tactile edge, rusty rail sides and overhead contact-wire/support infrastructure.
Inspected pedestrian-height Amory photograph: repeated white ribs, narrow weather cover, timber slat benches, transparent/blue/green panel families, platform paving and fine stone ballast.
Inspected elevated Central photograph: short shallow-wave metal shelter roofs, dark red structural frame and subdivided glass backs. Distinct from the continuous white Amory/Babcock structures.
Inspected standing-height Central photograph: green upper station name band, white lower route band and dark frame. The former 5.2m all-green floating plate was not a plausible equivalent.

retained: All five existing source stop positions, shared platform dimensions and access ramps, median axes, 1.435m gauge, terrain, track head +0.192m, travel paths and all ground/wall collision remain. Existing runtime contact wires remain the sole wire geometry.

implementation.singleOwner: createBUTransitDetail({mobile}) is called only by bu-green-line runtime. The street constructor supplies platform surfaces, ramps, rail profile, sleepers and ballast; no second shelter/nameplate remains there.
implementation.modern: Thin curved weather shell, dense tapered ribs, white posts on concrete feet, framed translucent panes, restrained blue/green material fields and wooden slat benches. Exact public artwork is not reproduced.
implementation.older: Retain short shelter category at East/Central/Blandford, with red frame and shallow-wave metal roof; Central photos establish the family, not a complete current survey of each old stop.
implementation.rail: Separate polished head and oxidised web/foot. Sleeper tops lowered from +0.152m to +0.107m to meet the foot instead of engulfing the web; ballast +0.073m and rail heads +0.192m unchanged. These are visual details, not additional walkable rails.
implementation.surfaces: Procedural world-metre stone color/normal relief and tactile domes; no texture request or added collision displacement. Tactile strip width is a photo estimate of 0.55m inside the existing platform; upper walking height remains +0.199m.
implementation.mobile: Same platform/roof outline and posts, fewer intermediate ribs/curve segments and one bench per modern platform. No baked texture payload. Station groups are merged by material; transparent screens remain separately sortable per platform.

estimatedNotSurveyed: Canopy rise, rib shape/pitch, support spacing, frame sections, concrete bases, bench construction and panel placement.
Station nameplate 2.15m by 0.46m and font; route band intentionally says only GREEN LINE B rather than claiming live destinations.
Track section, sleeper exposure, ballast stone size and tactile dome details. They are not construction dimensions or accessibility compliance claims.
Modern windscreen color fields represent material families, not the original artwork or exact panel inventory.
remainingGaps: Full intertrack and road-side safety fencing, electronic arrival signs, complete electrical fittings and every platform furnishing are not yet reconstructed.
No new MBTA surveyed shelter dimensions were obtained. These referenced, bounded architectural improvements are not a claim of complete station fidelity.
